shall create a ara::log::Logger instance with the given context ID and con-

The call to ara::log:-
:CreateLogger shall create a ara::log::Logger instance with the given con-
text ID and context description, and a log level threshold that is taken from Dlt-
LogSink.defaultLogThreshold in the Manifest for the DltLogSink that cor-
responds to the given context ID. If no such entry exists in the Manifest, then
LogLevel::kWarn shall be used.
⌋
